sentences.en: So, the medication builds up in their bloodstream.
sentences.zh: 所以，药物在他们的血液中积聚。

sentences.en: People say eventually, after a few days out in the sun, they say, I don't feel well in the sun.
sentences.zh: 人们常说，在阳光下待了几天后，他们感觉不太舒服。

sentences.en: They think there's something with the sun.
sentences.zh: 他们以为是阳光的问题。

sentences.en: Well, I think this might be a mechanism involved.

sentences.en: Vitamin D is increasing, and it's increasing the side effects of medications.
sentences.zh: 维生素D在增加，它加剧了药物的副作用。

sentences.en: As a result, more medication is being kept in the body.
sentences.zh: 结果，更多的药物滞留在体内。

sentences.en: It's not able to be processed and excreted.
sentences.zh: 它无法被处理和排泄。

sentences.en: And so, in the wintertime, the opposite could happen.

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Vitamin D levels are low.

sentences.en: A person might be lacking medication.

sentences.en: They might feel more depressed on their antidepressant in the wintertime when they're not producing as much vitamin D.
sentences.zh: 当他们在冬天维生素D产量减少时，可能会觉得抗抑郁药的效果更差，情绪更低落。

sentences.en: So, you have these fluctuations.
sentences.zh: 所以，存在这些波动。

sentences.en: I think those are very real.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些是非常真实的。

sentences.en: And a person can smooth those out by supplementing with vitamin D and keeping a more constant level throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 一个人可以通过补充维生素D来平滑这些波动，保持全年更恒定的水平。

sentences.en: But the good news is they could also achieve the ideal, in Mark's experience.
sentences.zh: 但好消息是，根据马克（Mark）的经验，他们也可以达到理想状态。

sentences.en: It's in gradually lowering the medication over time with the help of a prescribing clinician.
sentences.zh: 那就是在开药医生的帮助下，随着时间的推移逐渐减少药物剂量。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And eventually, what we find is the optimal dose of medication is zero.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们发现药物的最佳剂量是零。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Well, and, like, there's a million examples, but if you go through kind of older, you know, ancient world traditions,
sentences.zh: 嗯，例子有无数个，但如果你回顾一下古代世界的传统，

sentences.zh: 很多东西都是自然而然地摸索出如何去管理的。

sentences.en: A lot of food culture is around that, you know.
sentences.zh: 很多饮食文化都是围绕这一点展开的，你知道的。

sentences.zh: 直到相对现代的时候，人们才开始制作酸菜，以防止船员患上坏血病。

sentences.en: It's because you could keep sauerkraut, but you couldn't really keep citrus fruits.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When you use honey must and a lot of the natural stuff, you end up with vitamin K and vitamin D and probiotics.

sentences.en: It's that you're not getting as much sun, you know, in the winter because it's cold, and to survive in Norway, you've got to be in the mead hall or, you know, with a fire,
sentences.zh: 因为冬天冷，你晒不到那么多太阳，为了在挪威生存，你必须待在蜂蜜酒大厅里，或者待在火堆旁，

sentences.en: whereas in the summer, you're out on the ocean.
sentences.zh: 而在夏天，你则是在海上。

sentences.en: So, you know, a ton of those things are just the society left alone, you know,

sentences.en: But a lot of how we sort of are failing to have a myth or guiding principle or any sort of, you know, cultural center in the modern world, we lose all that stuff.

sentences.en: And then we don't know why we feel bad, and you guys are part of the project of trying to rebuild those things.
sentences.zh: 然后我们不知道为什么自己感觉不好，而你们也是重建这些东西的项目的一部分。

sentences.en: And money makes it difficult, okay?
sentences.zh: 而且金钱让这一切变得困难，明白吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that's the problem.
